fhirpath:
// Born more than 65 years ago
birthDate < today() - 65 years

// Who had a systolic pressure of 140 or more
entry.resource.ofType(Observation)
  .where(code.coding.exists(system = %loinc and code = '8480-6'))
  .where(value.ofType(Quantity).value >= 140)
  .subject.display
  .distinct()

/* The mean of every heart rate measured,
   rounded to one decimal */
entry.resource.ofType(Observation)
  .where(code.coding.code = '8867-4')
  .value.ofType(Quantity).value
  .avg()
  .round(1)
